_comment: Realistic OpenFEC /v1/candidates/ response, story 2.6.
The envelope and every field name/type below were captured from the LIVE
OpenFEC API during this story (2026-10-16) using the public DEMO_KEY, and
cross-checked against the endpoint's own swagger definition at
https://api.open.fec.gov/swagger/ ('Candidate' definition). Queries used:
GET /v1/candidates/?election_year=2026&office=H&state=DE
GET /v1/candidates/?election_year=2026&office=H&state=PA
GET /v1/candidates/?election_year=2026&office=S&state=DE
GET /v1/candidates/?election_year=2026&office=H&state=DE&incumbent_challenge=I
The first five results are VERBATIM live records (real 2026 filings).
The last four carry FEC-ids beginning H6XX/H4OLD/P6 that the FEC does not
issue in that shape; they are SYNTHETIC edge cases, each marked below, for
paths the live sample happened not to contain (a withdrawn filing, an
'I'-flagged candidate holding no matching seat, a stale election year, a
presidential filing). CI never touches the network: no FEC API key exists
in this environment, and DEMO_KEY's 10 req/hour ceiling is unusable for a
test suite even if it did. See app/ingest/candidacies.py's docstring.
candidate_status vocabulary, from the endpoint's own swagger description:
C = present candidate, F = future candidate,
N = not yet a candidate, P = prior candidate
incumbent_challenge: I = incumbent, C = challenger, O = open seat.

results._fixture_note: LIVE VERBATIM — DE at-large House, Republican challenger. district '00' is the at-large/statewide code.
results.name: ARMINIO, JOSEPH DR. JOE PH.D.

results._fixture_note: LIVE VERBATIM — DE at-large House incumbent. This is the record the incumbent-flagging scenarios cross-reference against a seeded sitting member.
results.name: MCBRIDE, SARAH ELIZABETH

results._fixture_note: LIVE VERBATIM — PA-2 challenger, has_raised_funds false (filed Form 2 without crossing the $5,000 bar; the spike's point that filing, not fundraising, is the gate). candidate_status 'N'.
results.name: ARRIAGA, JESSICA

results._fixture_note: LIVE VERBATIM — PA-3 unaffiliated, open seat. Proves a minor/unaffiliated filer does reach this feed when they file Form 2.
results.name: ARMSTRONG, SHEILA E

results._fixture_note: LIVE VERBATIM — DE Senate candidate. Senate records also carry district '00'; they must map to the statewide division, never to '/cd:0'.
results.name: APPELHANS, JEFFERY RYAN

results._fixture_note: SYNTHETIC — FEC flags this filer 'I' (incumbent) but no sitting member in `people` holds this seat. Proves is_incumbent is cross-referenced against real legislators, not copied from FEC's letter.
results.name: EXAMPLE, MISFLAGGED

results._fixture_note: SYNTHETIC — candidate_status 'P' (prior candidate) for the 2026 cycle: a filer who has withdrawn. Maps to candidacy status 'withdrawn'.
results.name: EXAMPLE, WITHDRAWN

results._fixture_note: SYNTHETIC — a 2024-only filing. The loader must skip it: it belongs to no upcoming election, and writing it would put a stale candidate on a 2026 ballot.
results.name: EXAMPLE, LASTCYCLE

results._fixture_note: SYNTHETIC — a presidential filing (office 'P'). Skipped: there is no congressional district to place it in, and 2026 is not a presidential election year. Real P-office records do exist in this feed year-round, so the loader must handle one rather than crash.
results.name: EXAMPLE, PRESIDENTIAL
